description: Succession vectors for BND-1 section 9. Valid events must verify with the stated form, history and approvals. Invalid events must fail with the stated reason. Resolution cases list event IDs from `events`; resolving them for the key must give the stated status and head(s). BIP-340 signatures use random auxiliary data, so the events are fixed here rather than reproducible.
mnemonic: leader monkey parrot ring guide accident before fence cannon height naive bean

valid.name: rotate the BCH key, approved by a transaction proof
recover from a lost Nostr key with the recovery key
revocation signed by the recovery key

invalid.name: stolen Nostr key alone rebinds to another BCH key
invalid.reason: needs approval from two keys of the previous binding, got only the nostr key

invalid.name: stolen BCH key alone moves the identity to another Nostr key
invalid.reason: needs approval from two keys of the previous binding, got only the bch key

invalid.name: old binding proof replayed as the BCH approval
invalid.reason: BCH key approval is invalid: message proof was not signed by the bound BCH key

invalid.name: approval signature for another successor
invalid.reason: Nostr key approval is invalid: approval signature is invalid

invalid.reason: event tags are not the required d, b and s tags

invalid.name: successor not newer than the binding it replaces
invalid.reason: a binding must be newer than the one it replaces

invalid.reason: invalid binding content: approvals.witness is not allowed
